evaluation_distribution_status: Exact Windows artifact and publication controls require separate review.
reviewed_behavior: JobLog trusted context and all public cursor state commit only after stable bounded reads, parsing, a post-parse reopen and consumed-window verification, and latest-file selection revalidation.
Three immediate unstable-snapshot retries; exhausted, missing, incomplete, or unanchored reads raise typed JobLogReadUnavailable instead of emitting an empty job or cached authorization.

Private provisional parser/cursor state permits bounded backlog progress, is checked against file identity and retained-byte hash on continuation, and never authorizes control before a complete anchored stable tail.
MonitoringCsvReader preserves its trusted job/file cursor when JobLog is unavailable; a verified real job change still invalidates the old observation.
Original control hold reasons, actual history-reset request counters and transition events are logged before the bounded GUI queue; control and Save admission predicates are unchanged.

independently_executed_tests.command: python -m unittest -v test_job_log_transaction test_csv_source test_excel_calculation test_hold_diagnostics test_log_session_continuity test_resilient_adapter
independently_executed_tests.scope: Working-tree bytes frozen without material changes into the pinned candidate; real-file and threaded integration fixtures use mocked native UI and Excel.

unchanged_guard_scope: Native Sequence IR and Save guards, pre-edit job and CSV token checks, maximum IR percent and 5 percentage point step limits.
Fresh baseline and new-layer requirements after unavailable control, sensor invalidity, actual job changes, and other existing barriers.
Excel formula engine, worker formula/order semantics, immutable workbook recovery, ownership retirement and process fences.
limits: Concurrent append injection reproduces a plausible code path; historical user status logs do not prove every reset had this exact cause.
Retained log verification is bounded to the existing maximum 8 MiB consumed window, with no full-file rewrite detection claim.
Prolonged or exhausted unavailability can still conservatively reset accepted calculation history under existing protection.
No actual Windows native application, Excel COM, sensor, PLC, lamp, physical Save, thermal behavior, or equipment validation was performed by this reviewer.
Final algorithm and equipment application remain on HOLD; this record is source approval only.
